integrity: The proof uses published automorphism-group structures and three-branch icosahedral geometry, together with explicit group-theoretic and Riemann--Hurwitz deductions. Numerical deductions are replayed by the bundled exact checker.
scientific_limitations: The result is over the complex numbers for the three specific source curves. It determines the commutator quotients, genera, and residual signatures but not explicit equations or a complete Jacobian isogeny decomposition. Older unindexed subgroup-signature tables remain a residual originality risk.
title: Maximal abelian quotients of three icosahedral Galois-point plane curves
